name: Alpenhotel Kramerwirt
beschreibung:
=== description ===

The Alpenhotel Kramerwirt in Söll is a four-star hotel located in the Hochsöll neighborhood, offering direct access to the SkiWelt ski resort. The rooms are stylishly designed in an alpine-modern aesthetic. The culinary offerings include a buffet breakfast and a dinner menu. The wellness area features an indoor pool, saunas, and relaxation zones. A children’s club and playroom are available for families with kids. In the summer, the house serves as a starting point for hiking and mountain biking adventures.
